description:
Welcome to a beautifully updated home that blends comfort, style, and effortless California living in one of Calabasas’ most desirable neighborhoods.
From the moment you enter, you’re greeted by light-filled spaces, fresh interiors, and a seamless flow designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The heart of the home is a bright, inviting kitchen featuring quartz countertops, crisp white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a charming farmhouse sink perfectly positioned beneath expansive windows overlooking lush greenery.
The inviting living room serves as a warm and elegant gathering space, featuring a cozy fireplace and beautiful French doors that open to a picturesque backyard with a sparkling pool—creating a seamless indoor-outdoor connection ideal for California living.
Set on an expansive .24-acre lot (approx. 10,405 sq ft), the property offers a rare sense of space and privacy, with a backyard designed for both relaxation and entertaining, enhanced by beautiful daytime and evening ambiance.
The home offers a spacious primary suite retreat with serene views and a beautifully updated bathroom, along with well-appointed secondary bedrooms that provide flexibility for family, guests, or a home office.
Thoughtful upgrades throughout include a brand-new roof (2026), updated plumbing, freshly painted interior and exterior, and remodeled kitchen and bathrooms, creating a true move-in-ready experience.
Located within the highly acclaimed Las Virgenes Unified School District, consistently recognized among the top-performing districts in California and the nation, this home also benefits from access to exceptional educational opportunities.
Ideally situated just minutes from The Commons at Calabasas, offering upscale dining, boutique shopping, and a vibrant village atmosphere, along with nearby Brandon’s Village Park, one of the area’s most beloved community destinations. Enjoy the best of coastal living as well, with the beaches of Malibu approximately a 20–25 minute drive away, offering easy access to ocean views, dining, and recreation.
This is a rare opportunity to own a beautifully maintained, thoughtfully updated home in an exceptional location.
